capabilities: Style internal links based on target note tags, frontmatter properties, folder paths, and Dataview inline fields
Define rules with light/dark colors, font weights, decorations, borders, and prefix/suffix icons or emojis
Apply link styling across editors, file explorer, backlinks, search, quick switcher, tab headers, and pop-out windows
Print and reset styling performance telemetry reports via commands
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README includes performance telemetry figures from a 200,000-node stress test and mentions AI tools were used as sparring partners during development.
intentEvidence: This plugin started as a mission to bring the beloved Supercharged Links workflow up to modern Obsidian standards
motivation: The author wanted to bring the Supercharged Links workflow up to modern Obsidian standards, which led to deep optimization work on V8 and CodeMirror 6.
problem: Obsidian renders all internal links alike, and older link-styling plugins struggle with performance in very large vaults.
